overview.Description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was formerly known as Maywood Acquisition Corp. and changed its name to Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in New York, New York.
